description: Aménagements cyclables sur Issy-les-Moulineaux is a dataset listed in Issy-les-moulineaux open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Seine Ouest. Localisation des aménagements cyclables et des zones de circulation apaisée sur le Territoire de Grand Paris Seine Ouest Un aménagement cyclable est un dispositif de voirie destiné à organiser la circulation des cycles non motorisés. Ces aménagements peuvent prendre la forme de chaussées dédiées aux cyclistes ou d'espaces pris sur la voie publique. Coverage: Issy-les-Moulineaux. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are vélo, personne à mobilité réduite, so mobility. The portal shows 515 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-10-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-issy-com-portal.
